text: A resume should contain reliable contact information.
A concise professional summary helps quickly explain the candidate's profile.
Experience bullets should begin with action verbs and describe concrete contributions.
Strong achievement bullets include measurable outcomes such as percentages, time, revenue, scale, or volume.
A clear skills section should contain technologies and competencies relevant to the target role.
A targeted resume should reflect important skills from the job description when they are genuinely supported.
Projects are useful evidence of practical ability, especially for students and early-career candidates.
